name: Hybrid Triangle Voxelization
definition: A compute-shader-based voxelization technique that processes triangles by first transforming them to cascade-local space, then deciding between direct voxel filling for small triangles or binning for larger ones to balance workload.
summary: Hybrid Triangle Voxelization is a compute-shader technique that dynamically chooses between direct filling and binning based on triangle size to balance workload and reduce memory contention.
